notes: Vietnamese sources write both 'Trúc Lâm Tam Tổ' and 'Tam tổ Trúc Lâm'; the Han form 竹林三祖 is confirmed in zh.wikipedia and in a CHIBS paper title (釋清慈《竹林三祖講解》). Query both word orders.

花煙寺 vs Hoa Yên tự: the Han sources write 煙 (yên, 'smoke/mist') while the Vietnamese reading is 'Yên'. The full title in the CHIBS paper is 安子山竹林第三祖玄光尊者詠花烟寺賦, with the simplified 烟. Query 花煙寺賦, 詠花煙寺賦 and 花烟寺賦.
上京記事 not 上京紀事: vi.wikipedia and vi.wikisource both give 記事 for Thượng kinh ký sự. A recalled 紀事 is a plausible-looking error; the verified form ships in this table.

sources.name: Kho tàng thư tịch cổ Hán Nôm (Thư viện Quốc gia Việt Nam)
sources.note: Catalogue of digitised Han-Nom holdings with shelfmark (Mã kho R.xxx), digitisation code (nlvnpf-xxxx), page count, dimensions, print type, and a Vietnamese abstract that often quotes the original Han title. The single most useful layer-1 entry point. NOTE: the deep path /hannom/ returns 404 to curl while the host root returns 200 — cite record URLs, not the app root.

sources.name: Nom Foundation digital library
sources.note: Mirrors the national-library records in a clean bilingual (Viet/English) layout with NLVNPF-xxxx identifiers. curl returns 000 from this network but the host resolves and the records are indexed by search engines, so it is bot-blocking, NOT dead. Use a browser session or reach the same record via hannom.nlv.gov.vn.

sources.name: Nom Foundation (main site, dictionaries and tools)
sources.note: Hosts the Tu dien chu Nom dan giai sources pages, which give per-work Han titles, script (Han vs Nom), verse form, shelfmark and holding institution. Verified in this session as the source of the 天南明鑑 record (HNv.006).

sources.name: Vietnamese National Library
sources.note: Institutional home of the R-series shelfmarks quoted in every catalogue record.

sources.name: Tạp chí Hán Nôm articles via Viện Nghiên cứu Hán Nôm citations
sources.note: University faculty site (literature and linguistics) hosting full-text scholarly articles in Vietnamese, including detailed textual-criticism studies with shelfmarks and edition collations. Verified reachable; used in this session for the Chỉ nam ngọc âm giải nghĩa dating debate.

sources.name: Trung tâm Nghiên cứu Quốc học / journal articles (secondary)
sources.note: University repository holding records and abstracts for classical works; useful for confirming an edition or a translator when the primary catalogue is silent.

sources.name: 中華佛學研究所 CHIBS bulletin (Chinese-language Buddhist scholarship)
sources.note: Full-text peer-reviewed PDF. Verified in this session as the source confirming 禪宗本行 and the full title of 詠花煙寺賦 with its 八言賦 98-line form. Chinese-language Buddhist-studies venues are a strong layer-2 source for the Thiền Trúc Lâm corpus.

sources.name: Vietnam Studies / Journal of Vietnamese Studies (JSTOR)
sources.note: Landing page resolves; article PDFs are paywalled. Use for English-language scholarship discovery, then obtain through a library.

sources.name: Journal of Vietnamese Studies (publisher site)
sources.note: curl 403. Publisher platform blocks non-browser clients; works in a browser.

sources.name: Từ điển Hán Nôm (hvdic.thivien.net)
sources.note: Han-Nom dictionary with per-entry Han form and, for book titles, a short definition citing Từ điển Nguyễn Quốc Hùng. Fast way to confirm a Han title. Verified this session for 天南餘暇集.

sources.name: Thi Viện (thivien.net)
sources.note: Large poet-and-poem database with Han author names (e.g. 阮秉謙) and long scholarly introductions quoting Vũ Khâm Lân, Phan Huy Chú, Lê Quý Đôn, Trần Văn Giáp on text history. Valuable for the transmission history of a poet's collected works; it is a secondary compilation, so cite the underlying scholar it quotes, not the site.

sources.name: Tự điển chữ Nôm trích dẫn (bibliography of Nom texts)
sources.note: Static bibliography listing 51 Nom works with Han title, author, source edition and date. Verified this session as the source for 詠花煙寺賦 / Huyền Quang. Personal-hosted mirror of a printed reference work: check against a library edition before citing in formal work.

sources.name: 中國哲學書電子化計劃 (ctext.org)
sources.note: The standard full-text corpus of received Chinese classics. curl returns 000 from this network but the host resolves and the site is heavily mirrored; treat as bot-blocking. Needed for the Chinese side of any comparative genre or thought question (志怪, 傳奇, 理學, 四書五經).

sources.name: Kanripo 漢籍リポジトリ
sources.note: curl 403. Open repository of Chinese-language texts, useful for edition images.

sources.name: Gallica (BnF)
sources.note: curl 403. Holds EFEO-era Vietnamese manuscripts and early printed quốc ngữ editions; relevant for transmission history of Nom works.

sources.name: Wikisource tiếng Việt
sources.note: Vietnamese-language public-domain texts, including full translations of works such as Thượng kinh ký sự and Vũ trung tùy bút with translator named. Good for reading a text fast and for confirming a Han title form; not a citable edition.

sources.name: 維基文庫 (zh.wikisource.org)
sources.note: Classical Chinese texts, including Vietnamese-authored Han works such as 平吳大誥. Use to read the Han original; confirm against a manuscript or printed edition before quoting.

sources.name: 識典古籍 (shidianguji.com)
sources.note: Full-text classical Chinese corpus. Verified this session as holding the complete text of 傳奇漫錄 卷之二 opening with 傘圓祠判事錄, which is how the Han title of that story was confirmed at character level. Strong for reading a work end to end; still layer 4 for citation purposes.

sources.name: 漢喃数字圖書館 (chunom.net)
sources.note: curl 000 but resolvable and indexed; mirrors national-library catalogue records with the same identifiers. Handy cross-check when hannom.nlv.gov.vn is slow.

sources.name: Việt Sử Đồ (vietsudo.org)
sources.note: Knowledge graph of Vietnamese history that quotes primary sources with the Han original inline. Verified this session as the source of the 大越史記全 thư 1697 Inner Cabinet edition quotation naming 天南餘暇集. Excellent for locating a Han phrase inside a named primary source.

sources.name: Wikipedia (vi / zh / en)
sources.note: Used in this session as a Han-character verification corpus via the MediaWiki API (142 pages fetched). Appropriate for confirming a character or a title form and for finding which named scholar or catalogue to cite. NOT a citable authority for a scholarly claim.

sources.name: Viện Nghiên cứu Hán Nôm (institute site)
sources.note: curl 000 (0.3s, connection refused/failed) while DNS resolves; http://hannom.org.vn returns 301. Measured unusable from this network in this session. The institute's catalogue content survives via hannom.nlv.gov.vn and lib.nomfoundation.org, so cite those instead. Re-probe before relying on it.

sources.name: Viện Văn học / ncvanhoc.org.vn
sources.note: DNS FAIL measured this session. Do not put this URL in a deliverable.

sources.name: vietnamvanhien.org
sources.note: DNS FAIL measured this session. Frequently cited in older reference lists; treat any citation to it as needing a replacement source.

sources.name: data.nlv.gov.vn
sources.note: DNS FAIL measured this session. Open-data endpoint does not resolve; use hannom.nlv.gov.vn for catalogue data.

sources.name: tapchinghiencuuvanhoc.vn
sources.note: DNS FAIL measured this session. Search for the journal's articles through a university repository or a database instead of linking the domain.

sources.name: Yale Southeast Asia Collection research guide
sources.note: curl 000, DNS resolves. Library research guide listing Han-Nom studies resources; useful orientation, open in a browser.

sources.name: hannom-rcv.org (Nom-language wiki)
sources.note: curl 403. Content written IN chữ Nôm with quốc ngữ gloss; of interest for Nom orthography, not a scholarship source.

sources.name: academia.edu
sources.note: curl 403. Hosts many relevant dissertations; needs a browser and often a login. Never cite an aggregator page — cite the dissertation itself.
